item.title: GSK PLC — GSK's B7-H3 ADC risvutatug rezetecan cut risk of death by 54% versus topotecan in relapsed small cell lung cancer in a pivotal China Phase III trial.
item.description: [HIGH] Risvutatug rezetecan (Ris-Rez) met the primary endpoint in Hansoh's ARTEMIS-008 Phase III China trial, reducing risk of death by 54% versus topotecan in relapsed small cell lung cancer ( HR 0.46; 95% CI 0.35–0.62; p ). Median overall survival was 18.5 months for Ris-Rez (n=230) versus 10.3 months for topotecan (n=231); first Phase III data showing an OS benefit for a B7-H3 ADC in any tumour type.
